title: ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENT COMMITTEE REPORT relative to maintaining the current Low Impact Development (LID) Ordinance, and related matters.
text:
[Council File 22-0600-S54]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENT COMMITTEE REPORT relative to maintaining the current Low Impact Development (LID) Ordinance, and related matters.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. MAINTAIN the current LID Ordinance No. 188125 and ADOPT the revised development service fees for the LID Program, together with the associated staffing levels necessary to provide full cost recovery, as further detailed in the fee study in Appendix G of the Bureau of Sanitation (BOS) report, dated April 13, 2026, attached to the Council file.
2. REQUEST the City Attorney to work with the BOS to explore legal mechanisms to authorize staff to inspect LID infrastructure on private property and to establish enforcement authority to issue penalties for unpermitted removal of required Best Management Practices, as further detailed in Appendix J of said BOS report.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the BOS. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Bureau of Sanitation reported on maintaining the current Low Impact Development Ordinance.
